name: text-area
description: Multiline field that reserves three lines so the form does not jump on the first character, then grows to six.
avoidWhen: Do not use for a single-line value; use text-field. Do not use ImeAction.Done — this is a paragraph.

ux.behaviour: The field is three lines tall before anyone types
ux.why: A one-line box that jumps on the first character feels unfinished

ux.behaviour: It grows to six lines then scrolls; maxLength counts without blocking
ux.why: You can see a long thought without the form exploding

ux.behaviour: Error shakes once, fires reject, and shows the message on the field
ux.why: The refusal is felt before it is read
ux.reducedMotion: No shake; haptic and text only

ux.behaviour: ImeAction.Default — the keyboard does not submit the screen

aiHints: Set isError on submit or blur, same as text-field
Do not force ImeAction.Done; people need a newline
